children: Sweden installation services firm's Q3 revenue rose 16.4% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Company acquired majority stake in Fabri AG during the quarter
Company expects delayed Norwegian projects to start in early 2027
Instalco sees encouraging signs in the market despite intense competition
Company says maintaining strong cash flow is a key priority
CHANGE INITIATIVES - Co said improved profitability and organic growth in Q3 were driven by ongoing change initiatives
SWEDEN PERFORMANCE - Co said subsidiaries in Sweden delivered improved results, contributing to profitability
SALES TRAINING - Co said increased sales training and operational support helped subsidiaries improve project selection and profitability
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the construction & engineering peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Instalco AB is SEK48.50, about 14.8% above its October 22 closing price of SEK42.24
The stock recently traded at 14 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 14 three months ago
